about: Topics already posted (or planned). /launch prepare and repick (launch.py load_posted) count them against a moment that repeats one: -2 points, -4 for a "strong" one (the owner's worst repeats). The dearest match counts, not a sum.

A topic matches a moment when any of its rules holds. A rule holds when all of its keys hold. Each key is a list (any of it): category (the moment's category, such as "star rise" or "crash"), topic (a topic candidate's id, such as "wanted-system"), term (a score term it has, such as "crash"), profile (gta6 or gta5), words (a word or phrase in what the frames say), all_words (all of these words).

type: the kind of Short (crash, star rise, heat-icons, discovery, news, ...). A moment of the same type as one of the last 2 POSTED Shorts is not picked while another candidate meets the payoff bar (payoff tier 2 or more): no crash right after a crash.

posted: the day it went up (YYYY-MM-DD). planned: the day it is meant to go up; a planned topic costs points like a posted one but is not one of the last 2 posted until it gets a posted day. Days taken from the Short's folder or the used-footage log where the owner gave none (motorbike crash: assumed Nov 20, the day it was made).

added: when a topic joined the list (ISO time). A re-pick of an older run leaves out topics added after it, and posted days after its day. The first list, from the owner on 2026-11-20, has no added time.
Only the owner adds or removes topics.
